name: Yoga school in Dubai
reason: No school's own website found in three searches. The best candidate, Yoga Ashram (Jumeirah Lake Towers; founded by Rashi Datt, Harsha Varyani and Jaya Harikumar per Gulf News; 200-hour Hatha training), appeared only in Gulf News, Yoga Alliance reviews, BookRetreats, HiDubai and a gym directory; no own domain found and domains are never guessed. Sri Sri School of Yoga (Art of Living, a global brand) and a Jivamukti satsang group were the only other Dubai items; the rest were BookRetreats listings for courses in India.
